messages:
Eve: Quick ask — NimbusAI PoC needs a hosted API burst next Mon 07:00-07:25 PT. They’ll run a client harness (~220 clients, ~6 rps each). Org: org-nimbus-123. Can we provision a scoped key + temporary quota bump and IP allowlist?
Liam: Which model/endpoint and average tokens per request? Need tokens/sec for sizing.
Eve: Using /v1/generate, model redwood-2.0-medium. Avg ~360 tokens (prompt + response). Ballpark = 220 * 6 * 360 = 475,200 tokens/min. Requesting 600k tokens/min for cushion over a 30m window.
Harpreet: Capacity check — 475k/min ~7.9k tokens/sec. us-west-2 hosted pool can support that if we reserve capacity for a short window. Suggest token_quota_per_minute=600000, concurrent_request_limit=300, and a 30m valid window + 5m pad. Need exact UTC times and IP ranges. Also recommend routing fallback to quantized variant to avoid hard 429s.
sec-bot: Security requirements: scoped key only (no org master), IP allowlist mandatory, mask prompt fields in logs (prompt_text, user_message), retention 72h for this key, disable external audit export for temp keys. Provide a named contact for DSR questions.
Eve: Contact is support@nimbus.ai. Planned UTC window: 2026-07-14T14:00:00Z/2026-07-14T14:30:00Z. I’ll DM IP ranges now. Graceful fallback preferred.
Harpreet: OK will reserve. Sample admin create command I’ll run after IPs arrive: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" \n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \n  -d '{"org_id":"org-nimbus-123","name":"nimbus-poc-burst","scopes":["gen:invoke"],"token_quota_per_minute":"600000","concurrent_request_limit":"300","valid_window":"2026-07-14T14:00:00Z/2026-07-14T14:30:00Z","routing_policy":{"fallback_model":"redwood-1.3-small","response_header":"X-RW-Fallback"}}'
```
ops-bot: ACTION: reserved capacity on pool us-west-2 for tag "nimbus-poc-burst" 100 rps equivalent 1 ticket INF-5231 (user: Harpreet)
Harpreet: I’ll attach an alert: page if 5xx > 1% for 5m OR median latency > 500ms. We'll auto-throttle the key if cross-customer impact is detected.
sec-bot: Confirmed: logs masked for prompt_text and user_message, retention 72h, exports disabled. IP allowlist pending.
Harpreet: Scoped key created: sk_nimbus_poc_7123. Token quota=600000/min, concurrent cap=300, fallback configured to redwood-1.3-small with X-RW-Fallback header. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/poc/nimbus-7123.
Eve: Thanks team — I’ll share the scoped key and IPs with Nimbus runbook. Please monitor during the window and call out >1% 5xx or median latency >450ms.
Liam: I’ll join monitoring and coordinate rollback if needed. Good to have the fallback behavior to avoid sharp failures.
Eve: Closing loop — will post results after the test and any cost/latency notes. Appreciate the quick turn :rocket:
